body.name: Intersection-packing construction
body.construction: At \(t=U(o,e)\), initialize \(t_i=(t-c_i)_+\), enlarge \(t_i\leq b_i\) and \(t_0\leq p_0\) until \(t_0+\sum_{i\in\mathcal J}t_i=t\), place a common event of mass \(t_i\) in each factual-success block and mass \(t_0\) in the unqueried block, then fill coordinate \(i\)'s remaining success demand outside its own stratum by \(\operatorname{TAKE}\).
